Based on the retrieved excerpts, the sub-clause that requires assessing OH&S opportunities is **clause 6.1.2**.

This clause explicitly states that the organization must "assess OH&S risks from identified hazards **and assess OH&S opportunities**, using defined methodologies and criteria" (Doc 3 — clause 6.1.2).

Additionally, clause 6.1.1 establishes the broader context by requiring the organization to "determine the risks **and opportunities** that need to be addressed" when planning the OH&S system (Doc 1 — clause 6.1.1).
